**Mikajy Atlas — free to download, for non-commercial use only.** You may use, share and modify it; you may not sell it or use it commercially
(code: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, trained model: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).

Mikajy Atlas installs **next to** Mikajy Spark (its own app, its own history and settings) and is updated only by Mikajy Atlas releases from this repository. (This edition was previously named Mikajy Free, and earlier Mikajy Max.)

Credits: the handwriting recogniser was trained with **MathWriting** (Google LLC, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and mathematical expressions from
**Wikipedia** contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0), and with synthetic strokes from SIL OFL handwriting fonts. Calculus by **Nerdamer** (Apache-2.0)
and decimal.js (MIT). Full texts: `LICENSE`, `licenses/`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

**Accuracy, honestly:** about 5 in 10 expressions written with a stylus are read exactly right (MathWriting test ink: 53.3 %); with a finger it is 31 % on a small test of 29 samples, so expect misreads. Tap a symbol to correct it, scribble over a line to erase it.
